Epson PowerLite 770F UST laser projector - landscape
[V] CAD unit price read Sep 18 2026 from Epson Canada. [U] selection / quantity; stock and rear-fabric test not confirmed.
Playback PC - two independent 1080p video outputs
[U] allowance; verify GPU outputs and actual playback performance. Shared by both projectors.
[U] allowance; retains 15 x 8 ft wall panel. Image band is 15 x 4.5 ft. Sample-test UST performance.
Two landscape mounts and perimeter screen tensioning
[U] allowance: mounts 500-1,000 plus tensioning 300-800. Main tunnel structure excluded.
Two video feeds, adapters, power and network cables
[U] allowance: video 200-400 plus power / control 250-600. Do not use a mirroring splitter.
Rear service-bay blackout, shipping and consumables
[U] allowance: blackout 500-1,200 plus shipping / brokerage / consumables 200-600. Keep cooling and service access.
[U] 25% contingency for a design still being tested. Edit percentage in A60.
Project Hours - Shared design, development and testing
Design 4-8 h + procurement 4-8 h: layout, optical placement review, screen / mounting plan, sourcing and receiving.
Full-size rear-fabric proof of concept 8-16 h. Test focus, hotspots and viewing angles using one candidate projector.
Playback / projection-control software 12-24 h: two independent outputs, mapping, blending and supplied animation playback. No visitor tracking.
Integration 8-16 h: mounting / enclosure preparation 4-8 h plus bench configuration and alignment 4-8 h. No custom PCB.
Testing 6-12 h: two-projector seam, brightness / colour matching, screen tension adjustments and content playback.
QA 2-4 h: complete-wall acceptance checklist, power restart and soak setup / review. Unattended soak time is not billed as labour.
Public deployment uplift x1.4: add 40% of base project hours, rounded up. Covers recovery, durable mounting / cabling and operator reliability.
Documentation 4-8 h: wiring / layout records, configuration backup and operator handover.
On-site install is priced in the installation block below. Zero here avoids counting it twice.
25% iteration buffer on design + prototyping + programming + integration after x1.4 uplift. Rounded up; design-only hours are in A58.
